title: Groom in Tuxedo at Outdoor Wedding, 1950 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white snapshot taken outdoors on June 24, 1950, depicting a sharp-dressed groom adjusting his tuxedo jacket lapel. In the background, women in full-length formal dresses and gowns gather under the shade of a tree. This photo reflects post-WWII American wedding traditions and mid-century formal menswear fashion.
